objective: Create the contract package with core types: SpecScenario, ScenarioContract, ScenarioAssertions, ContractAssertion, FileContainsAssertion, ContractFailure. All types must have proper YAML struct tags. ContractAssertion uses single-key map pattern (exactly one field set). SpecScenario and ParseScenarios must be exported for reuse by spec 0002f. Add ContractWriter and ContractEvaluator interfaces in this package.

Implement ParseScenarios function that parses spec markdown to extract scenarios. Match '### Scenario:' headers. Extract Given/When/Then/Notes blocks as raw text. Skip scenarios missing When or Then with a warning log. Given and Notes are optional. Export the function for reuse by spec 0002f.

Implement ValidateContract function that checks a ScenarioContract against the known assertion vocabulary. Each ContractAssertion must have exactly one field set. Unknown keys (zero fields set or multiple fields set) are vocabulary violations. Return a list of validation error strings. Also implement ParseContractYAML that strips markdown code fences from raw LLM output and unmarshals YAML into ScenarioContract. Fix the review finding: doc comment must use plain English, no backtick-escaping artifacts.

Implement DefaultContractEvaluator with Evaluate method that checks all 5 assertion types against the filesystem: file_exists (os.Stat), file_contains (strings.Contains), file_not_modified (git diff --name-only HEAD -- <path>), file_not_exists (!os.Stat), file_not_contains (!strings.Contains). All assertions per scenario are checked (no short-circuit). Failures use format 'contract:<scenario-name> — <assertion-type> failed: <details>'. Missing contract file (nil contract) returns empty failures. Use pointer receiver for consistency.

Create the contract writer prompt template. Address review finding: use //go:embed with a separate .txt file instead of awkward backtick escaping via string concatenation. The prompt instructs the LLM to translate scenarios into the 5-assertion vocabulary (file_exists, file_contains, file_not_modified, file_not_exists, file_not_contains) and output YAML matching the ScenarioContract schema.

Implement LLMContractWriter that satisfies the ContractWriter interface. Takes an LLM adapter and tier. Renders the prompt template with scenarios and spec packet, invokes the LLM, returns the raw response. Uses Sonnet (P1) model tier. Also create a noopContractWriter for use when no LLM provider is configured.

Add ContractsWritten bool field to RunState in runstore/types.go with json tag 'contracts_written'. Do NOT add it to the per-cycle reset block in specloop.go (it must persist across replan cycles). Add new event types ContractsWrittenEvent (with ScenarioCount int) and ContractsBlockedEvent (with Reason string) to events.go. Register both in the unmarshalEvent switch.

Implement WriteContractsStage in stages/write_contracts.go. Config struct: WriteContractsStageConfig with SpecPath, EvidenceDir, Budget (*specloop.Budget). Constructor takes ContractWriter interface, store (*runstore.Store), config, and eventLog. Stage name: 'write_contracts'. Run logic: (1) check rs.ContractsWritten idempotency flag — if true return Continue, (2) read spec file and parse scenarios — if none return Continue, (3) check budget before LLM invocation — if exhausted return Blocked, (4) read spec-packet.md from store, (5) invoke ContractWriter, (6) parse and validate response with retry loop (max 3 attempts total: 1 initial + 2 retries). Address review findings: construct fresh request each iteration preserving original specBytes; clear lastErr at top of each loop iteration; wrap error context in code fence when appending to retry prompt. (7) Write scenario-contracts.yaml to EvidenceDir, (8) set rs.ContractsWritten = true, (9) emit contracts_written event. On terminal failure: emit contracts_blocked, return Blocked.

Extend ValidateStage to check contract assertions. Add EvidenceDir string field to ValidateStageConfig. Add ContractEvaluator interface (same signature as contract.ContractEvaluator) to stages package — do not import contract package's interface (avoid dead code). Add contractEval field to ValidateStage struct. Update NewValidateStage constructor to accept optional ContractEvaluator. In Run method: (1) if contractEval is set and EvidenceDir is set, attempt to load scenario-contracts.yaml — if file missing skip silently, (2) evaluate contracts against workDir, (3) collect contract failures into the failures slice, (4) then run existing shell validation checks regardless of contract results, (5) combine all failures. Contract failures use format 'contract:<scenario-name> — <assertion-type> failed: <details>'. Update existing tests to pass with the new constructor signature.

Wire WriteContracts into the pipeline in stage_provider.go. (1) Create LLM adapter for ContractWriter using FallbackAdapter with Sonnet tier, cost and invocation callbacks. (2) Construct WriteContractsStageConfig with SpecPath, EvidenceDir, and Budget (fix the review finding: Budget must be wired as 'Budget: budget'). (3) Insert writeContractsStage between planStage and executeStage in the returned slice. (4) Create noopContractWriter in stage_provider.go for the no-provider fallback path. (5) Wire ContractEvaluator into ValidateStage constructor using contract.DefaultContractEvaluator. (6) Update ValidateStageConfig to include EvidenceDir. (7) Do NOT add 'write_contracts' to dryRunStages in exec.go. (8) Add 'write_contracts' to filterStagesForResume skip list (same as compile — contracts written in prior run).
